payload.artist_html: T. Szczygielski, F. Celestin, S. Adnet & G. Guinot
payload.credit_html: "Triassic turtles of France: the first European Rhaetian stem turtle taxon (clades Testudinata, Proterochersidae)"
payload.description_html: A. Geographical map of the Pégairolles-de-l’Escalette locality. Red star indicates the location of the samplings; B. Simplified geological section of the Rhaetian Formation at Pégairolles along the RN9 road (see Lopez (1992)) modified from Courtinat and Piriou (2002) with close-up on the base of the Upper Unit of the Lower Member (modified from Lopez (1992)). Red star indicates the horizons that yielded the Bartassochersis lopezi fossils described here. Letters M, W, P, G, F and R, on the horizontal axis correspond to the Dunham classification, respectively Mudstone, Wakestone, Packstone, Grainstone, Floatstone and Rudstone. Letters a, s, f, m, g, c and b correspond respectively to claystone, siltstone, fine sandstone, medium sandstone, coarse sandstone, conglomerate, and breccia. Scale bar: 10 km.
